property_summary: After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any uint256 input, the betLimit value equals that input.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the difficulty state variable remains unchanged.
The state variable 'difficulty' is never modified by a call to AdjustBetAmounts.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, currentDifficulty() returns a value that is congruent to the last amount set by AdjustDifficulty modulo some invariant.
the value of currentDifficulty() is always less than or equal to the last amount passed to AdjustDifficulty
AdjustBetAmounts should not affect the mapping wagers of any address
The value of betLimit after AdjustBetAmounts is always equal to the amount parameter passed to it, regardless of openToPublic's value.
After any sequence of calls, calling AdjustBetAmounts should not change the balance of the whale address.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the value of openToPublic remains unchanged regardless of the parameter passed.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract must not revert when a new player places a wager with the exact updated betLimit.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract should not revert when any user calls wager with the new bet limit.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the wagers mapping for the user who calls wager with the new bet limit should remain unchanged (zero) until the wager function completes successfully.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called by the owner, the betLimit value returned by currentBetLimit equals the amount passed as argument.
After owner calls AdjustBetAmounts(newLimit), the play() function cannot be called by a contract (msg.sender != tx.origin) without reverting, because onlyRealPeople requires msg.sender == tx.origin.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, c.hasPlayerWagered(address(1)) is always false.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the betLimit state variable must equal the argument passed to AdjustBetAmounts.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the balance of the whale address must equal the sum of all transfers sent to it via loseWager and donateToWhale calls, which is reflected in totalDonated.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any argument, the openToPublic state variable must remain unchanged from its value before the call.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the betLimit state variable must equal the argument passed to it when openToPublic is false, and must always be exactly the value even if the modifier is bypassed.
After adjusting the bet limit, the contract's balance remains unchanged if no one wagers.
Adjusting the bet limit does not cause the winnersPot() to equal the betLimit.
After adjusting the bet limit, the contract's winnersPot() is always at least as large as half the new bet limit when no player has wagered.
After adjusting the bet limit, the contract's winnersPot() equals half the adjusted bet limit if no player has wagered.
After adjusting the bet limit, the contract's balance is always an integer multiple of half the new bet limit.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the winnersPot (half of contract balance) equals half of the contract balance.
After adjusting bet limit, the contract's winnersPot is always exactly half of ethBalance
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's ethBalance is unchanged (no ether was transferred out).

After adjusting the bet limit, the contract must still have its balance decremented by exactly half when a loss occurs (i.e., the winnersPot after playing a losing round should be less than before), but the bug always pays out half on loss so it doesn't decrease.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's totalDonated must be zero if no other function has transferred ether to the whale.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called, the contract's ether balance always equals the totalDonated.
After AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's ether balance is always at least half of what it was before the call.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's ether balance is never decreased by more than half of the betLimit.
After AdjustBetAmounts, the winner's pot (balance/2) is always at least totalDonated - (previous contract balance before call).
After AdjustBetAmounts, the winner's pot (balance/2) is always equal to totalDonated if totalDonated is greater than zero.
After adjusting bet limit, losers' donation to whale is exactly half the new bet limit.
After `AdjustBetAmounts`, the contract's ether balance is never halved by a subsequent call to `play`.

After AdjustBetAmounts sets betLimit to L, calling play() always transfers exactly L/2 to the whale (through loseWager) for any difficulty D and any random seed, because the winning condition's divisor mismatch makes it impossible to win.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets betLimit to L, the contract's ether balance never exceeds totalDonated by more than 2*L.

After AdjustBetAmounts sets betLimit to L, the value of winnersPot() is always exactly half the contract balance minus half of L (because the bug makes winning impossible, so half the contract balance is never paid out).
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract balance is equal to the sum of all wagers minus the amount donated to the whale on losses.
After AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's whitelisted balance only decreases when a player loses in the original, not when they lose with zero amount.
After AdjustBetAmounts, the contract balance is exactly twice the amount that was paid out to the winner on a win (if any), else unchanged.
After AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's totalDonated is increased by the amount sent to whale on a loss, which is zero in the buggy version.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the totalDonated state variable is exactly equal to the sum of all amounts sent to the whale via donate and loseWager, which differs when loseWager transfers zero.
After AdjustBetAmounts, donate does not revert when called with msg.sender equal to address(this).
After AdjustBetAmounts, donate always succeeds when called with value = 0 by an EOA (tx.origin = caller).
After AdjustBetAmounts, donate does not revert when called by the contract itself (msg.sender == address(this)).
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, donating any positive value from any sender reverts if and only if msg.sender == address(this).
After adjusting the bet limit, the contract can donate to itself (msg.sender == address(this)) without reverting.
The contract's ethBalance() always returns the actual balance of the contract.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with a specific limit and then making a wager, the contract's ethBalance is at least the wager amount.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, ethBalance() returns the actual contract balance, not half of it.
After any sequence of operations ending with a call to AdjustBetAmounts, ethBalance() returns the full contract balance, not half of it.
After any number of operations, the contract's balance is always an even number when ethBalance is called.
ethBalance() always returns the sum of betLimit of all players who have wagered and not yet played.
After AdjustBetAmounts, ethBalance() returns the same as address(c).balance.
The returned currentDifficulty() value is exactly the same as the last value set via AdjustBetAmounts(uint256)
The return value of currentBetLimit() should equal the value set by the last AdjustBetAmounts call.
After AdjustBetAmounts(amount), currentBetLimit() returns amount.
hasPlayerWagered returns false for an address that never wagered
For any player who has wagered, hasPlayerWagered returns true if the player's wagered amount is greater than 0.
After adjusting the bet limit, the contract's bet limit equals the new amount.
If a player has not wagered, hasPlayerWagered returns false.
hasPlayerWagered returns true for an address that has successfully wagered
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the result of c.hasPlayerWagered(player) must be false if c.wagers(player) is zero.
After adjusting bet limit, the function hasPlayerWagered returns false for any player.
A player who has never wagered should have hasPlayerWagered return false.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, hasPlayerWagered returns true if and only if a player has placed a valid wager, not just made a timestamp entry.
After adjusting bet amount, hasPlayerWagered returns false for an address that has not placed a valid wager (wagers mapping = 0).
For any address, hasPlayerWagered returns false if AdjustBetAmounts has not been called in a way that affects wagers.

After AdjustBetAmounts is called, for any address player, hasPlayerWagered(player) returns true if and only if wagers[player] > 0, which is the same as hasPlayerWagered(player) being equivalent to c.wagers(player) > 0 (since wagers is public).
